bugs.pattern: Pattern E — Context Loss After Policy Acceptance
bugs.description: After the user accepted the privacy policy (turn 9), the bot lost all booking context: service (mechas), stylist (Pilar), and slot (sábado 13 jun 11:00). It responded 'Me falta la información del servicio' despite having confirmed the slot in turn 7. The user was forced to re-dictate all three booking parameters from scratch in turn 10.
bugs.hypothesis: The policy acceptance gate introduces a state transition that does not correctly preserve partial_resolved_ids and the active booking draft. When policy_accepted_at is written to state, the draft booking fields (service_ids, stylist_id, slot) are likely reset or not forwarded across the graph turn boundary.
bugs.impact: Severe UX degradation. Customer must repeat booking information after accepting policy — this is likely to cause abandonment in production. Compounds on top of the existing 3-pivot context retention challenge.
bugs.workaround_observed: User manually re-provided full booking context in turn 10; bot booked correctly on recovery.
